plainText:
Volume 1 is the first volume published by VIZ Media compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. The chapters in this volume are collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures and are collected independently of Shogakukan's collected releases of the magazine version. 

==Blurb==
Sun dreams of money. Moon dreams of scientific discoveries. When their paths cross with Team Skull, both their plans go awry...

Moon is on her way to deliver a rare Pokémon to Professor Kukui in the Alola region when she meets his good friend Sun, a courier entrusted with a special Pokédex. Sun offers to safely deliver Moon to the professor's lab... But then they tangle with a group of grunts from Team Skull and are attacked by a mysterious Pokémon!

==Publications==
 
 

==Chapters==
Adventure 1: The Grand Entrance and Delivery Boy Sun
Adventure 2: The Delivery of Rotom and the Girl
Adventure 3: Pokémon Move Specialist Professor Kukui

==Major events==
 
Moon arrives in Alola with the goal of delivering a to Professor Kukui
Moon meets Sun on the beach, who is tossing into the ocean
Team Skull accuses Sun of not finishing the job, and picks a fight with Sun and Moon
Sun announces his goal is to save up a million dollars
Sun and Moon travel to Professor Kukui's house in Hau'oli City
Moon makes medicine using fruits she shot out of a tree using a bow and arrow and heals Sun's broken leg
appears out of the sky
After Sun tries battling the it shoots into the sky, leaving behind a Sparkling Stone
At the Professor's house Moon delivers her to the Professor, who refuses to enter Sun's Pokédex because it's stinky and dirty
The Island Kahunas battle discuss that the Tapus are angry, and hope a battle festival with the young trainers of Alola will produce a winner that can calm their anger
Moon receives a Rowlet from the Professor
Sun prepares deliveries for the battle festival
Sun is approached by Professor Kukui, who is mad at Sun for not reporting his sighting of to Kahuna Hala, and signs Sun up for the battle festival to make up for this mistake

==Party changes==
===Additions===
Moon's obtained from Professor Kukui in PASM03
===Evolutions===
No Pokémon evolve in this volume
